title: •The Time For Our Attack Has Come
caption: The Time For Our Attack Has Come (V)
game_text: If you just deployed or moved a second Rebel starfighter to a system, deploy a {independent} starship there from under your Starting Effect; deploy on that starship: it is power and hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition < 5. Once per game this starship may make an additional move. {control}
lore: “With the Imperial Fleet spread throughout the galaxy in a vain effort to engage us, it is relatively unprotected.”

notes: Banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT, no grabber box → grabber false (printed base is already an Immediate Effect). UNIQUENESS: the printed card is unique ('•The Time For Our Attack Has Come' on the scan, wiki Unique) but the slip's heading and caption print NO dot — title keeps the printed dot, caption follows the slip; the stub's uniqueness field is blank. Inline icon: a small round sphere with blue/white/red diagonal stripes = the Independent icon (stub reads 'an Independent starship') → {independent} (the slip prints 'a'). Text ends with the red circle-slash C → {control}. Margin credits printed vertically: left 'Original concept by David Destefanis', right 'DeckTech Contest Winner 2004'. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes (wiki has straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line SE-style with 2000, partly legible. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
